---
title: "Configuration"
---

This guide shows how to change the site.
Two files control how the site looks.

## The site file

The file `_quarto.yml` holds the title, the navigation, and the options of the site.
Change the `title` and the `description` first.

```{.yaml filename="_quarto.yml"}
website:
  title: "My project"
  description: "A short description of my project."
```

Change `repo-url` to the address of your repository.

## The brand file

The file `_brand.yml` holds the colours of the site.
Each colour has a `light` value and a `dark` value.
The site uses the `primary` colour for the current item and for links.

```{.yaml filename="_brand.yml"}
color:
  primary:
    light: "#1d5fd1"
    dark: "#7fa8f0"
```

::: {.callout-tip}

## Test both colour schemes

Change the colour scheme of your system.
Make sure that the text is easy to read in both schemes.

:::
